candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not observed; timeout cause (saturation vs network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating inventory 503 -> order ReadTimeout -> gateway 502 on /v1/checkout, matching the alert. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Gateway metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2387ms) and 502s.
